text: Novo targets 5+ multi-blockbuster launches by 2030 and DKK 150B+ in risk-adjusted pipeline sales by 2035. Obesity and diabetes remain foundational alongside blood, endocrine, liver, and cardiovascular areas. Shares traded 5.4% lower.
